book.name: Madyu
book.title: Madyu Jisas Krais Manö Aij u Madyu kalɨ kƚiñ rɨka

content: God sabe gep ram u ud waƚ gɨnaböl, a ga
Jisas God sabe gep ram u arö göm, höŋ arö nɨŋöl gɨ, bɨ nɨpe gau nɨp hagla, “God sabe gep ram aij gai i nöŋ!” a gɨla.
Hageila, kalɨp haga, “Kale nan anɨb gau magöŋhalö nɨŋmim hagabim u pen yad kalöp nɨŋö yabɨƚ hagabin, hainö ram i ud waƚ gɨnaböl u, kabö ap kabö ap adö u rö mɨdageinab,” a ga.
Hainö mɨd aij gagnaböl

Jisas am Olip Dum laŋ asɨk mɨdö nɨŋöl gɨ, bɨ nɨpe gau apöm, kalpe ke nöp ap Jisas nɨp agamɨj hag nɨŋöm hagla, “God sabe gep ram ud waƚ gɨnaböl a gɨpan u, mañ mai rö anɨg gɨnabölŋ Hon nan nɨhön u gö nɨŋun, ne söl aunabön nɨŋöm ram mɨnöŋ naböŋ iƚ i ur gɨnab, a gun nɨŋnabun?” ö gɨla.
Hageila, Jisas haga, “Nɨŋ aij yabɨƚ gɨmim. Nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap kalöp piral hagnaböl.
Bɨ iru nöp apöm, nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp pir alöm, hib yad u udöm hagnaböl, ‘Yad nöp Krais u,’ a gɨnaböl. Nɨbi bɨ iru nöp manö piral kale u nɨŋ udnaböl.

Söl au pen pen gɨlö, gu gö nɨŋnabim; pen mɨlö yabɨƚ gau pen pen gɨnaböl u, manö u nöp auö nɨŋnabim. Anɨg gö nɨŋmim, ñɨn hain u aunɨg gab a gɨmim pɨñɨŋ gagmim. U yɨharɨŋ pen pen alnaböl. Ñɨn hain u hainö aunab.
Nɨbi bɨ mɨgan rɨmnap uraköm, nɨbi bɨ mɨgan rɨmnap aip pen pen gɨnaböl. Kiŋ mɨgan rɨmnap uraköm, kiŋ mɨgan rɨmnap aip pen pen gɨnaböl. Ram mɨnöŋ gau magöŋhalö munmon udöm, kɨyö kub yabɨƚ apöm gɨnab.
Anɨg geinab, kalöp nɨbi ñɨ pai ñɨŋöb rö u gö, söl mɨdöp a gɨmim nɨŋnabim.
“Kale nɨbi bɨ yad mɨdeinabim rö, nɨbi bɨ ram mɨnöŋ gau magöŋhalö kalöp iru nɨŋöm, dam nagɨ löm, gɨ naij göm, böŋ nöp al pak lɨnaböl.
Ñɨn anɨbu, nɨbi bɨ God nɨp nɨŋ udpal gau iru nöp nɨŋ udep magö kale u arö göm, mɨdeimam kale ke gau nɨŋlö mulu lugö, kalɨp ud bɨ kauaƚ mauaƚ ñɨmagö adö u lɨnaböl.
Pen nɨbi bɨ iru nöp apöm, “Hon God manö hagep bɨ,” a göm, manö piral haglö, nɨbi bɨ iru nöp manö piral kale u udnaböl.
Nɨbi bɨ gau nagɨ naij adö u gɨlö gɨlö, magöŋhalö rö gasɨ adö anɨbu nɨŋöm, mɨdmagö lep adö u hauƚ gɨnaböl.
Pen nɨbi bɨ an God manö aij u nɨŋ ud pɨdöŋ göm, hagöp rö göm, nɨbi bɨ ke nɨbö gau mɨdmagö löm gɨ nöp mɨdeinaböl gau, God nɨbi bɨ anɨb gau kalɨp magöŋhalö ud kamɨŋ yunab.
Pen God nɨbi bɨ udöm abad mɨdeinab manö aij u, ram mɨnöŋ ke gau gau nɨbi bɨ ke ke gau nɨbö gau nɨbö magöŋhalö yabɨƚ haglö haglö am haknɨg gab u me, ñɨn hain anɨbu aunab.
Bɨ ap God sabe gep ram u gɨ naij yabɨƚ gɨnab, a ga

“Pen bɨ God manö hagep Daniel hadame nöp haga rö u gɨnab. Nɨpe haga, ‘Kale nɨŋnabim, God sabe gep ram raul mɨgan uɫ u, nan asɨ masɨ naij yabɨƚ gep ap urak mɨdeinab,’ a ga. (Kale nɨbi bɨ manö i uri nöp amgö lɨ nɨŋabim gau, manö anɨbi iƚ u nɨŋ aij gɨmim!)
Kale nɨbi bɨ ram mɨnöŋ Judia mɨdeinabim gau, nan naij anɨbu nɨŋmim, yɨŋɨd pɨñɨŋ gɨ nö ilö gau armim.
Nɨbi bɨ ram adö laŋ mɨdeinabim gau, nan hon rɨmnap udun a gɨmim, ado gɨ ram raul aragmim.
Nɨbi bɨ wög naböŋ gau ajeinabim gau, waƚɨj mɨlö ap udun a gɨmim, ado gɨ ram aragmim.
Pen ñɨn anɨbu nɨbi ñɨ mudun halö mɨdeinabim gau abe, nɨbi ñɨ paiŋaŋ ci ñeinabim gau abe, uɫham yabɨƚ arnabim.
“Pen God nɨp sabe gɨmim hagmim, ram yɨgön göp ñɨn u pɨñɨŋ gɨ aragun, a gɨmim; God nɨp sabe gep ñɨn kale u gagnɨm, a gɨmim.
Nɨhön gɨnɨg, God hadame dagol gau ram mɨnöŋ gɨ la ñɨn u rɨköm, mɨd damöm mɨñi mɨdpun ñɨn i, nan naij anɨbu rö gaga; hainö anɨbu rö gagnab.
Yɨharɨŋ u, nan naij anɨbu pör gö, nɨbi bɨ magöŋhalö um hakblap. Pen Bɨ Kub u nɨbi bɨ nɨpe udnab gau kalɨp gasɨ nɨŋöm, wasö gö me, nan naij anɨbu yöp magö ap gɨnab.
“Ñɨn anɨbu nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap kalöp hagnaböl, ‘Nɨŋim! Krais mɨdöp i! Krais mɨdöp daŋ!’ a gɨnaböl u, pen nɨŋö hagpal a gɨmim, nɨŋagmim.

Nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap, God nɨbi bɨ nɨpe hag la gau, böŋ hanɨp lau aulaŋ a göm, piral hagöm hagnaböl, ‘Yad me Krais; yad me bɨ God manö hagep bɨ ap,’ a göm, nan gagep rö rɨmnap gɨnaböl. Pen God nɨbi bɨ nɨpe hag la gau udagnaböl, wasö.
Anɨb u, nɨŋ aij gɨmim. Nan nɨhön nɨhön hainö gɨnab u, yad kalöp hadö hagnö nɨŋbim u me, nɨŋ aij göl gɨ mɨdaimim.

“Anɨb u, nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap apöm kalöp hagnaböl, ‘Krais apöm mɨdöp ram mɨnöŋ kabö nöp mɨdöp aŋ gau,’ a gaiöl u, anɨb gau aragmim. Rɨmnap pen hagnaböl, ‘Krais apöm pi göl mɨdöp gai i,’ a gaiöl u, nɨŋö hagpal a gɨmim nɨŋagmim.
Yad Bɨ Ñɨ nɨpe aunabin ñɨn u, añɨm añɨm udöm, amdam magö bol u adɨŋ mɨŋ nɨbö adɨŋ jɨŋ aröp rö u gö nɨŋöl gɨ, aunabin.
Wal wayöŋ ap umöl mɨdeinab u, yaur apöm magum geinaböl.
Bɨ Ñɨ nɨpe aunab ñɨn u
“Pen marö kub anɨbu gɨ dam pɨs gö nɨŋöl gɨ, sɨdö u mailö gagnab; rakɨn u mailö gagnab; gapɨ gau kumi kabö laŋ nɨbö ju lugnab; nan kumi kabö adö laŋ gau, gau nɨbö gau nɨbö gɨnab.

Ñɨn anɨbu, Bɨ Ñɨ nɨpe aunɨg gö nɨŋöl gɨ, kumi kabö adö laŋ ke lö, nɨbi bɨ ram mɨnöŋ gau ke ke mɨdpal rö nɨŋöm, mɨɫöŋ gɨnaböl. Bɨ Ñɨ nɨpe Nap pɨdöŋ u udöm, mailö aij unbö ke halö kumi bad adö au auö nɨŋöl gɨ, nɨŋnaböl.
Aƚɨŋ magö kub hagö nɨŋöl gɨ, ejol nɨpe gau hag yuö, nɨbi bɨ nɨpe, udnabin, a göm hag la gau udnɨg, ram mɨnöŋ iƚ i mɨdöp mɨdöp rö gau gau amöm, udöm nɨp daunaböl.
Mab rauan u nɨŋmim
“Kale nɨŋbim, mab rauan uɫaŋ sɨƚɨp löm, söl pɨdöŋ gɨnɨg gab nɨŋöl gɨ, sɨdö lɨnɨg gab a gɨmim nɨŋbim.
Anɨb u rö, hainö nan hagpin gau gö nɨŋöl gɨ, “Bɨ Ñɨ nɨpe ado gɨ aunab ñɨn u mɨñi söl yabɨƚ mɨdöp; magö pro marap mɨdöm, apjaknab,” a gɨmim, nɨŋnabim.
Yad kalöp nɨŋö hagabin, nɨbi bɨ mɨñi mɨdpal gau umagnaböl, kamɨŋ mɨdlö nɨŋöl gɨ, nan anɨb gau magöŋhalö gɨnab.
Kumi kabö adö laŋ abe, mɨnöŋ naböŋ iƚ i abe ur gɨnab, pen manö magö yad ur gagnab.
Ñɨn mai yad Bɨ Ñɨ nɨpe aunabin u, nɨbi bɨ ap nɨŋagöp, a ga
“Yad magö mai rö, ñɨn mai rö aunabin u, nɨbi bɨ nɨŋagpal; ejol gau nɨŋagpal; yad ke God Ñɨ u pen yad abe nɨŋagpin; Bapi nɨpe ke nöp nɨŋöb.
“Yad Bɨ Ñɨ nɨpe ado gɨ aunabin ñɨn u, Noa mɨdeia ñɨn u, gɨ mɨdmɨdal rö nöp gɨ mɨdeinaböl.

Hadame nöp Noa mɨdeia ñɨn anɨbu, ñɨg u nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp ud yuö yuaga magö u, kale nan ñɨŋöl gɨ, ñɨg ñɨŋöl gɨ, nɨbi bɨ udöl gɨ, gɨ mɨdlö nɨŋöl gɨ, Noa ñɨg magɨb kub mɨgan u arö, ñɨg apöm kalɨp magöŋhalö ud yuö yua.
Pen kale nan ap gɨnab a göm nɨŋagla; ñɨg u kalɨp ud yuö yuö nɨŋöl gɨ nöp nɨŋla. Hainö yad Bɨ Ñɨ nɨpe aunabin mañu, anɨg unbö rö nöp gɨnab.
Ñɨn anɨbu, bɨ mɨhöp wög adɨŋ gau wög gɨ mɨdeinabil u, bɨ ap udem, ap arö gɨnabin.
Pen nɨbi mɨhöp plaua gɨnɨg, wid magö pa jö ma jö ƚugaƚug geinabil u, ap udem, ap arö gɨnabin.
“Yad Bɨ Kub aunabin ñɨn u nɨŋagpim u me, nɨŋ aij göl gɨ mɨdaimim.
Bɨ ram nap nɨbö u, bɨ nan si udep u magö mai aunab u nɨŋböp, nɨŋ aij gɨböp; ram nɨpe pa jö gɨ raul daŋ am nan nɨpe gau si udagböp.
Anɨb u rö, kale gɨ jɨn gɨmim mɨdaimim. Wasö u, Bɨ Ñɨ nɨpe auagab a gɨmim, hauƚ padö gɨ mɨdeinabim ñɨn u nöp aunabin.
Bɨ wög gɨ ñeb rɨmnap wög gɨ aij gɨpal, rɨmnap wög gɨ aij gagpal, a ga
“Bɨ kub ap adan arnɨg göm, bɨ an wög gɨ aij gɨnab u nɨp hag löm hagnab, ‘Bɨ wög yɨp gɨ ñɨbal rɨmnap kalɨp abad mɨdmön, nan magö kalɨp gau nɨme lɨ aij göl gɨ mɨdaimön,’ a göm, arnab.
Hainö ado gɨ apöm nɨŋnab, haga rö nöp geinab. Anɨg nɨŋöm nɨp ud aij yabɨƚ gö nɨŋöl gɨ, bɨ wög gɨ ñeb nɨpe mɨñ mɨñ gɨnab.
Yad kalöp nɨŋö hagabin, nɨp hag lö, nan nɨpe gau magöŋhalö abad mɨdeinab.
“Pen bɨ nɨpe hag lɨnab anɨbu mɨd damöm, bɨ kub mɨñi auagnab, a göm,
nɨbi bɨ wög gɨ ñeb rɨmnap kalɨp mɨñu magö paköm, am bɨ ñɨg ñɨŋöm hauƚ lɨbal gau aip aŋ haköm, nan ñɨŋöm, ñɨg ñɨŋöm gɨ mɨdeinab.
Bɨ wög gep anɨbu, bɨ kub yɨŋɨd auagnab, a göm, hauƚ padö göm mɨdeinab ñɨn u nöp, bɨ kub aunab.
Apöm, nɨp gɨ naij yabɨƚ göm, nɨbi bɨ piral hagöm, “Hon Bɨ Kub nɨbi bɨ nɨpe me,” a göm piral hagpal gau aip hag yunab. Hag yuö, kale am meg hau rɨbɨköm, mɨɫöŋ gɨ mɨdeinaböl.
